name: Notes
author: WinDock
description: A note: its first line is the title, the lines after it show as space allows. Click it to edit the note in a small text editor window (Ctrl+Enter or OK saves, Escape cancels); the wheel scrolls the text. Each item keeps its own note; give two items the same Note id to share one.

settings.label: Font size
settings.description: On a dock the text gets smaller when the lines would not fit the tile.

settings.label: Text colour
settings.description: #00000000 (transparent): automatic, a dark ink on coloured paper, the theme's text colour otherwise.

settings.label: Lines under the title
settings.description: As many of them as fit the tile's height are shown; the wheel scrolls through the rest. A left or right dock shows the title only.

settings.label: Widest tile
settings.description: The tile grows with its text up to this width (top and bottom docks).

settings.label: Note id
settings.description: Empty: this item's own note. Items with the same id (on any dock, or on the desktop) show and edit one shared note.
